items.explanation: Hours use the feminine "eighth": Jest ósma.
optionNotes: Hours do not use the plain number.
The masculine form; godzina is feminine.

items.explanation: After o (at) the hour ends in -ej: o siódmej.
optionNotes: After o the ending changes to -ej.
Hours do not use the plain number.
The -ą ending is not used after o.

items.prompt: Jest wpół do dziewiątej. What time is it?
items.explanation: Wpół do dziewiątej is "half to nine": 8:30.
optionNotes: Polish counts half an hour to the next hour: 9:30 is wpół do dziesiątej.

items.prompt: How do you say "in the evening"?
items.explanation: "In the evening" is one word: wieczorem.
optionNotes: A word-for-word copy of the English.
